text: DSH Autoresearch 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的自动实验循环，用户可在项目会话中设定研究目标和轮数，让 agent 修改项目、运行基准并记录指标；实验结果会保留或回滚，并可暂停等待用户决定。输入 /autoresearch 可创建、继续、查看或停止实验，Web 会话面板展示进度与历史。账本保存在项目 .auto 目录，循环使用当前会话的模型。

DSH Autoresearch adds durable experiments to DeepSeek Harness. Set a goal and iteration limit; the agent edits a project, runs benchmarks, records metrics, and keeps or reverts results. Manage runs with /autoresearch and view progress in a Web session panel. The ledger lives in .auto.
想让 DSH 按目标反复修改项目并用基准指标比较结果
怎么在项目会话里启动并暂停一个自动实验循环？
I want an agent to run repeated project experiments and keep the changes that improve my benchmark.
DSH Autoresearch 的功能「持久化实验循环」：在项目会话输入 /autoresearch 并填写目标与轮数，agent 可运行基准、记录指标，并根据结果继续、完成或等待用户决定。实验账本记录每轮结果。

dsh-autoresearch README · DSH Autoresearch：[English](./README.en.md)

为 DeepSeek Harness 添加持久化的自动研究循环：创建目标后，Agent 连续修改、测量、保留或回滚，会话顶部面板显示结果。当前正式版 **1.0.11**，适配官方 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5**。

dsh-autoresearch README · 安装：**桌面版 / DSH Studio**：打开 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，输入：

```text
github:aa2246740/dsh-autoresearch#v1.0.11
```

按插件管理器提示完成安装。普通用户无需 clone 仓库或本地构建。

**Web 版**：确保官方 `dsh`、Node.js 22.19+ 和 `pnpm` 在 PATH，运行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:aa2246740/dsh-autoresearch#v1.0.11
```

Web CLI 只管理 Web profile，不会安装进桌面版。CLI 安装后正常重开该 Web Host，再打开页面。仓库和 [Release](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-autoresearch/releases/latest) 提供预编译产物；也可下载 Release 的 `.tgz`，从同一官方入口安装本地包。

升级时安装最新 Release。卸载使用桌面插件管理器，或：

dsh-autoresearch README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-autoresearch
```

dsh-autoresearch README · 开始使用：打开一个项目会话，输入 `/autoresearch`，选择新建研究，填写目标和轮次并确认。运行会修改项目文件并执行本机命令；插件不会上传或 push 项目代码。它沿用该会话的模型，持续执行会消耗模型额度。

本版把 Host peer 对齐到 `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2`：接受 `0.2.1-rc.5`，拒绝 `0.2.1` alpha，也拒绝 `0.2.0` 与 `0.1.7-rc.2`。

实验循环源自 [grok-autoresearch](https://github.com/aa2246740/grok-autoresearch) / [pi-autoresearch](https://github.com/aa2246740/pi-autoresearch)。

dsh-autoresearch README · 命令：| 命令 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `/autoresearch` | 新开一次、继续、查看、停止或清除 |
| `/autoresearch resume` | 继续一轮已暂停的研究 |
| `/autoresearch status` | 查看当前持久状态 |
| `/autoresearch off` | 停止自动续跑，保留已有结果 |
| `/autoresearch clear` | 清除当前项目的 Autoresearch 账本 |

开始前会建本地保护：能用 Git 就保存基线，否则用插件私有快照。`discard` / `crash` / `checks_failed` 时恢复受保护文件。模型说「完成」不算结束，账本写入 `complete` 才会停。需要取舍时暂停问你。

账本在项目 `.auto/`：`prompt.md`、`measure.sh`、可选 `checks.sh`、`log.jsonl`、`ideas.md`、`config.json`。

dsh-autoresearch README · 开发：日常安装不用这一步。改 TypeScript 后用 **pnpm** 重建已提交的 `lib/`：

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-workspace
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build

dsh-autoresearch README · DSH Autoresearch：[中文](./README.md)

A durable research loop for DeepSeek Harness: set a goal, then let the agent edit, measure, keep or revert changes while the session panel shows progress. Current release: **1.0.11**, targeting official **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5**.

dsh-autoresearch README · Install：**Desktop / DSH Studio:** open **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin** and enter:

```text
github:aa2246740/dsh-autoresearch#v1.0.11
```

Follow the plugin manager's installation result. No clone or local build is required.

**Web:** with official `dsh`, Node.js 22.19+ and `pnpm` on PATH, run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:aa2246740/dsh-autoresearch#v1.0.11
```

dsh-autoresearch README · Install：The CLI manages the Web profile only, not Desktop. Reopen that Web Host after CLI installation, then open its page. The repository and [Release](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-autoresearch/releases/latest) contain precompiled files. You can also download the Release `.tgz` and install it through the same official entry point.

To upgrade, install the latest Release. To uninstall, use the desktop plugin manager or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-autoresearch
```

dsh-autoresearch README · Start a run：Open a project session, enter `/autoresearch`, choose a new run, supply the goal and round limit, and confirm. Runs modify project files and execute local commands. The plugin does not upload or push project code. It uses the session's model and consumes that model's allowance while running.

This release retargets the Host peers to `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2`. That range accepts `0.2.1-rc.5`, rejects `0.2.1` alphas, and rejects the `0.2.0` series and `0.1.7-rc.2`.
dsh-autoresearch README · Start a run：The loop is based on [grok-autoresearch](https://github.com/aa2246740/grok-autoresearch) / [pi-autoresearch](https://github.com/aa2246740/pi-autoresearch).

dsh-autoresearch README · Commands：| Command | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `/autoresearch` | New run, continue, status, stop, or clear |
| `/autoresearch resume` | Continue a paused run |
| `/autoresearch status` | Current durable state |
| `/autoresearch off` | Stop auto-continue, keep results |
| `/autoresearch clear` | Clear this project's Autoresearch ledger |

dsh-autoresearch README · Commands：Before a run it takes a local safety point: a Git baseline when that works, otherwise a private snapshot. `discard` / `crash` / `checks_failed` restore protected files. A model saying "done" does not finish the loop. The ledger must write `complete`. Value tradeoffs pause for you.

The ledger lives in project `.auto/`: `prompt.md`, `measure.sh`, optional `checks.sh`, `log.jsonl`, `ideas.md`, `config.json`.

dsh-autoresearch README · Develop：Skip this for a normal install. Rebuild the committed `lib/` with **pnpm** after TypeScript changes:

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-workspace
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
